# E28 build plan

Planning evidence only. The design stays frozen. No implementation or gate pass is claimed. At inspection, hub/, ui/, eval/, contracts/api/ and non-pharmacy runtime configuration were absent. The package contains eight example plans, not the required seven condition plans plus twenty flow plans and remaining family plans (docs/tdd/E28.md:551). docs/requests/E28.md is absent. Recheck the tree and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before dispatch because other planners are active.

## Build order and connections

| Task | Concern and ownership | Depends on | Handoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | Pure model, availability, views, rechecks, aggregate, release and tool rules; hub/tests/plans/domain/ | E01 kernel/types/fakes | Immutable domain calculations and exhaustive transition tests |
| T2 | authoring/plans/, config/onboard-plans.json; hub/tests/plans/authoring/ | T1; E27 row/source inputs | Deterministic expanded document with real independent source checks |
| T3 | Application, SQLite, API, tool adapters and printed cards; hub/tests/plans/runtime/ | T1; E01/E02/E23/E26/E27 | Six real HTTP operations, owner ports, transactional engine and CLI |
| T4 | ui/crew/src/features/plans/, including component and browser tests | T3; E03 shell, E20 cache and accepted UI seams | Configured Assessment, pinned run view and immediate cached help |
| T5 | eval/scenarios/e28/ | T2, T3; actual counterpart providers | Real-stack HTTP, tool, fault, content and printed-backup acceptance |

T2 and T3 run in parallel. T4 and T5 run in parallel after their own dependencies. T3 is the sole runtime safety owner; T5 reports defects to that owner instead of editing production code. T4 owns browser acceptance, so T5 does not wait on T4 or reproduce its work. The coordinator combines both evidence sets. Tests stay with their owner; no shared conftest or harness edits.

The exact source allocation is docs/tdd/E28.md:881. New test subdirectories are partitions of its hub/tests/plans/** allocation. T3's file list expands the design's brace lists, never the entire plans directory. module.py, settings/projection manifests and the SYSTEM migration location are deliberately not assigned: the frozen allocation omits them or disagrees with SYSTEM. Resolve request P28-1 before composed runtime acceptance. No task owns another epic's configuration, root toolchain, fixture, generated contracts, shared scripts, design or AI-use log. Ownership checked against all available design section 13 allocations and build task lists, including E02, E03, E05 and E21. Plans with an empty tasks array reserve no implementation path.

SYSTEM sections 5.1 to 5.12 supply all shared mechanisms, section 6 supplies uv/pnpm and generated contracts/import gates, sections 8.1 to 8.6 supply seams/privacy/authority/durability, and sections 9/10 supply dependencies/fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md:163,1623,1799,2338). E28's hard integration prerequisites are E01/E02/E23/E26/E27, not every neighbor named by the old design. Missing optional facts are typed unknowns, never sample data. Build unit tests against published provider protocols and kernel.testing; no local provider copies. A missing protocol or fake blocks dependent work until its owner supplies it. Integration acceptance uses actual providers, not kernel fakes inside the hub.

## End-to-end evidence

Every row drives create_app(settings) through its HTTP boundary with a real temporary SQLite data directory, or Playwright against that running hub. Use the normal composition, authentication, configuration loader, command ledger, audit and subscribers. No dependency overrides, fake repositories, direct SQL clinical seeds or mocked hub responses. Seed only through E21's explicit demo profile and documented owner bootstrap APIs. External model/device/transport adapters may be absent or documented fakes; the hub stays real. Missing positive paths fail acceptance rather than becoming skip/xfail or denial-only tests.

| Owner and traces | What the test proves |
|---|---|
| T5: V81, D34, T28-24/31; EI2/EI5 | Compare plans plus the real warning/routine/kit/help responses with link up, delayed and down. Only the package's explicit ground fields differ. Run ICL10 through start, valid manual/guided completion, substitute, escalation and close with model stopped, devices absent and transport down. No care state waits. |
| T5: V82, D32, T28-20/36/41 | Submit/activate a sourced scratch release with an officer-only row: LIVE rejects with row/environment, SIM reports the exact gap. Verify example 7/7 and full 119-row counts across server views, and feed T4 the same counts for UI equality. Invalid candidates retain last good. |
| T5: V83, T28-02/03/04/07/08 | Missing instrument or supply, missing/absent helper and changed environment cannot execute. Selecting a substitute leaves it open; completing its own eligible step debits once. Concurrent last-stock uses commit at most one action. |
| T5: V84, T28-19/43 | Through real E12/E13 gateway/output policy, reject unknown/unrunnable step and dose-bearing prose, retain configured order/text and reference-only rejection evidence; accepted get_plan/explain_step remain read-only. No model process is necessary for deterministic policy execution. |
| T5: V94, T28-26 | Eye plan on lunar surface shows sourced return content; Mars/transit omit return and render configured no-return text. Movement also prevents lunar-only prepare actions. |
| T5: V95, D40, T28-01/16 | Approve the particular run's handoff through E16, observe queued and next-contact leaves_at, continue/close care, deliver a late reply. No step changes; no episode-based link inference. D40 remains blocked until the handoff contract is accepted. |
| T4: D36, D39, T28-34 | Real Assessment has gap/form link, role-engine helper/reasons, accepted guided launch and result; ring stays, no diagnostic exclusion or old summary action; Log for the ground opens the real preview. Model is off. |
| T4: V97, T28-37 | Warm signed public cache, stop hub, render pinned steps and version plus immediate help. After lock/restart no clinical run/person state or current eligibility is reconstructed. |
| T4: V98/T28-35; T4 and T5: T28-36 | T4 runs the E21 scanner on feature sources/built assets. A sourced scratch step/copy change alters rendering with the same bundle. T5 supplies loader/API evidence; T4 supplies browser evidence. |
| T5: T28-09/12/13/14/15/17/29/30/32/42 | Pins survive several activations/restart; same key on another target conflicts; late accepted retry never repeats; commuting races/rechecks preserve one effect. Crash at each intent/help/plan boundary, disk full, missing/corrupt pins/config, clock corrections and bounds fail visibly. Current object/field grants cover HTTP, full-schema events, errors, tools, replay and exports. |

V81/V82/V83/V84/V94/V95/V97/V98 and D32/D34/D36/D39/D40 are all required, including D32 from the product brief (docs/product/tdd/E28.md:9; docs/product/VALIDATION.md:101,187). T28-38 measurements owned by T5 use the reference machine and frozen inputs; numerical verification is distinct from clinical validation. T1/T2/T3 own T28-01 through T28-30 and T28-39 through T28-43 at their unit/integration level; T5 upgrades relevant cases to HTTP acceptance. T4 owns T28-34 through T28-37 browser evidence. Every test carries the design test ID and R/V/D/invariant trace, not a coverage-only rationale.

Reserve parent intent and stable occurrence before E26, child internal.plan_help_entry commits first, reconcile by escalation_id, complete parent only after plan commit. ## Gates and hand-in

Exact task gates are in tasks.json. Python uses uv run --project hub and explicit hub pytest configuration; JavaScript uses pnpm. Import contracts are generated and then checked, never a bare unconfigured lint-imports pass. T5 runs all owned Python tests, branch instrumentation limited to plans.domain/application, corpus/trace/safety/mutation gates and full hub suite. T4 runs full UI lint/types/tests plus its real browser suite. The shared gate must enforce each domain/application file's branch result, not just an aggregate percentage. Missing prerequisite, gate command, positive scenario, surviving non-equivalent safety mutant, CI result or independent review is reported plainly and prevents epic greenlight. No filter, skipped scenario or disabled check turns missing acceptance green. No implementation gates were run by this planner.
